chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Sonet royalties on Tiny's Exercise and the 1977 date
summary: He complains that Sonet paid him a thousand dollars for a 1977 session and never any royalties, and wants it printed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: ... It went over pretty good. But like, boy, the royalties that are being taken from the black man is pitiful... The people just take. They don't even have the courtesy -- Sonet does have the courtesy to send you a thing that's always wrong,
Now, I'm gonna have to say this, & I would like for it to be printed. I made this record for Sonet for a thousand dollars...

... Anyhow I still get statements from them, now this is myself, Roy Eldridge, Percy Heath, Lloyd Glenn on the piano... and... Eddie Locke was on drums... I received a thousand dollars to make the date. I don't know what Roy got or the other people got. ... And so I got a thousand dollars for the date and to this day, every year or every six months or something they send me something that I still owe them. Now this is real weird... Now evidently I did the date for free... Out of the thousand dollars in six years I never got a dime. ... Somehow they're dipin' their hand always in the till...
